metadata.title: Palantir, Zeta Team Up on Marketing Platform

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Palantir Technologies (PLTR, Financials) is moving deeper into marketing through a new partnership with Zeta Global.
The companies said Zeta will rebuild its Data Cloud on Palantir's Foundry platform. Zeta's AI tool, Athena, will then use that data to help companies plan campaigns, understand customers and measure results.
The idea is to give large businesses one place to manage customer data and turn it into marketing decisions. Palantir brings the data infrastructure. Zeta brings the marketing engine.
Palantir CEO Alex Karp said the partnership is meant to help companies use AI while keeping stronger control over their data. Zeta shares rose 4.4% in premarket trading after the announcement.
For Palantir, the deal adds another commercial use case beyond defense and operations. For Zeta, it could open the door to more enterprise customers already using Foundry. The next thing to watch is whether the partnership turns into named customer wins.
